kpis.name: Regional Weekly Revenue
kpis.definition: Sum of closed-won order value per region per week, in USD.
kpis.formula: SUM(units_sold * avg_price_usd) GROUP BY region, week

kpis.name: Average Selling Price
kpis.definition: Revenue-weighted average unit price per region per week.

kpis.name: Deal Win Rate
kpis.definition: Share of closed deals (region, week) that closed as won, plus loss-reason tagging.
kpis.formula: COUNT(outcome='won') / COUNT(*) GROUP BY region, week_closed
lineage: CRM opportunity records -> nightly export -> deals.csv

kpis.name: Price/Competitor-Related Complaint Volume
kpis.definition: Count of support/CRM tickets per region per week whose text references price or a named competitor (via retrieval + keyword/semantic match).
kpis.formula: COUNT(tickets WHERE topic IN ('price','competitor')) GROUP BY region, week
lineage: Support platform + call transcripts -> text extraction -> customer_tickets.csv

kpis.name: Regional Marketing Spend
kpis.definition: Total marketing spend per region per week across paid channels.
lineage: Ad platforms -> marketing data warehouse -> marketing_spend.csv

notes.sparse_history_kpi: APAC-South region within regional_revenue only has 4 weeks of history (launched week 9) - Pattern agent should return low-confidence/no-analog for this segment.
notes.low_confidence_case: EMEA complaint_volume ticket text is dominated by a resolved billing outage, not price/competitor signal, and EMEA revenue is flat - this should NOT be conflated with the APAC story; used to test the Falsifier's ability to reject a spurious correlation.
notes.role_based_security_scenario: A regional_sales_manager scoped to EMEA querying APAC data should be denied/masked at row level, with the attempt logged for audit.
